name: Email marketing
blurb: Lists and consent, lifecycle flows, campaigns and A/B tests, deliverability, React Email and MJML, sending APIs, ESPs and email law.
searches: Gmail Yahoo Microsoft bulk sender requirements update email
email deliverability DMARC agent skill new
React Email MJML template agent skill
lifecycle email automation Klaviyo MCP skill
CAN-SPAM GDPR CASL email compliance change

tests.prompt: Our marketing emails started landing in spam at Gmail last week. We send about 20,000 a week from news@ourbrand.com through Mailchimp. What do we do?
tests.good: Treats it as an acute problem and works the diagnosis order: new or changed sending, then SPF (one record, under 10 lookups), DKIM aligned, DMARC present, checked on a received message's headers; one-click unsubscribe headers; Google Postmaster spam rate and reputation; blocklists; recent imports or old segments added; content last. Pauses broad sends if complaints are at or above 0.1% and mails only 30-day clickers, suppresses bounces and complainers, plans a DMARC ramp and separate marketing subdomain, and sets a 2-4 week monitoring plan. Does not judge on opens.

tests.prompt: Write an abandoned cart flow for our Shopify store in Klaviyo. We sell skincare, average order is $45.
tests.good: Designs the flow before copy: trigger Started Checkout, exit on Placed Order checked before every email, exclusion of orders in the last 4 hours, re-entry once per 7 days, Smart Sending off. Email 1 at 1-4 hours plain reminder with cart items and no discount; email 2 at 24 hours objections (reviews, shipping, returns); email 3 at 48-72 hours small incentive for first-time buyers only, split on that condition. Gives a text diagram, subject options with preview text, one CTA each, merge-tag fallbacks, no invented reviews, and RPR as the KPI.

tests.prompt: Set up password reset and order confirmation emails for our Node app using Resend and React Email.
tests.good: Builds both as React Email templates (Tailwind with pixelBasedPreset, Preview first in Body, box-border on Button, alt text, plain text via render). Reset email: expiry, single-use link, ignore-if-not-you line. Order email: ID, line items, totals, addresses, status link. Sends from a verified transactional subdomain with a monitored reply-to, checks the SDK's returned error instead of try/catch, uses idempotency keys like order-confirm/<id>, retries only 5xx and 429, verifies Svix webhook signatures on the raw body, suppresses bounces, tests with delivered@resend.dev and bounced@resend.dev, and keeps promotions out.

tests.prompt: We sell handmade candles on Shopify. I want a scent quiz as a lead magnet, the landing page for it, and a welcome email flow that follows up based on the quiz result, all in our brand voice.
tests.good: States a plan first: quiz magnet, consent and segments from strategy-and-list-growth.md (unchecked opt-in, double opt-in, quiz result tagged), the branching welcome flow from sequences-and-lifecycle.md, templates from templates-and-html.md, warm-up and unsubscribe checks from deliverability.md; the landing page through website-building (plan-and-copy.md: one promise, proof, short form); the voice through content-creation (brand-voice.md) applied to every email. Branches on quiz result, exits on first order, invents no reviews, and checks the Done means of all three crafts, saying what wasn't verified.

tests.prompt: My Shopify store has about 6,000 subscribers in Klaviyo, but my Gmail open and click numbers have dropped and some mail is going to Promotions or spam. Check my setup, tell me what to fix, and build me a 3-email abandoned cart flow with the right settings. Don't send anything yet.
tests.good: Connects through the official Klaviyo MCP (OAuth) or a restricted read-only key and keeps secrets out of chat and files. Checks Google Postmaster Tools spam rate and domain reputation against the 0.1% and 0.3% thresholds, and confirms SPF, DKIM and DMARC align on a received message from a dedicated sending domain with a branded tracking domain. Segments by engagement (0-90 days) and flags unengaged profiles before the flow goes out. Builds the flow with the Started Checkout trigger, exit on Placed Order, Klaviyo's docs don't say to turn Smart Sending off for abandoned cart; Smart Sending is on in many pre-built flows and can be toggled per flow message (Skip recently emailed profiles). Say 'review Smart Sending per message' instead, sensible waits (about 1 hour, 24 hours, 48-72 hours), exclusions, and The abandoned cart dynamic block reads the items from the triggering Started Checkout event data; catalog sync is needed only for product-feed and recommendation blocks. Leaves the flow in draft or manual status, shows a pre-send review with preview, links and unsubscribe, and asks for explicit approval before anything goes live. Reports checked, unchecked and unverified items, with click, conversion and revenue-per-recipient targets rather than opens.

tools.name: Klaviyo
tools.why: Leads AI-engine and Shopify/DTC recommendations in the 2026 Email Marketing Platforms Citation Share Index and has 147k+ detected sites (technologychecker Q1 2026); fastest-growing large ESP (+28%).

tools.name: Mailchimp
tools.why: Largest by user count (about 11M users) and top detected install base (283k sites, Q1 2026) per EmailToolTester and technologychecker; default ESP for small businesses.

tools.name: HubSpot Marketing Hub
tools.why: Second-largest by customers (about 278k) and the default B2B ESP tied to a CRM, 121k detected sites (EmailToolTester, technologychecker 2026); ranks 2nd in the AI Citation Share Index.

tools.name: Amazon SES
tools.why: Cheapest at scale ($0.10 per 1,000) and the default high-volume sender in developer round-ups (Courier, SuprSend 2026 comparisons).

tools.name: SendGrid
tools.why: Called the enterprise workhorse of email APIs in 2026 comparisons (SuprSend, DevToolLab); one of the four standard transactional providers.

tools.name: Resend
tools.why: Developer favourite of 2026: 3M users by June 2026 and 6.8M weekly npm downloads of its SDK (buildmvpfast, Courier round-ups).

tools.name: Kit
tools.why: Default ESP for creators and newsletters in 2026 round-ups (Dupple, Sequenzy, beehiiv comparison); free to 10k subscribers; official remote MCP with 65+ tools.

tools.name: Google Postmaster Tools
tools.why: The only source of Gmail spam-rate and domain-reputation data; Gmail and Yahoo bulk-sender rules make it the standard monitor for every sender (Google's own guidance).

tools.name: Litmus
tools.why: The standard email rendering and pre-send QA tool (100+ clients); Email on Acid is being folded into Mailgun Inspect from June 2026 (Mailtrap and Mailosaur round-ups).

tools.name: Postmark
tools.why: Best-regarded for transactional deliverability in 2026 round-ups (buildmvpfast, Courier).

tools.name: Customer.io
tools.why: Standard pick for product-led SaaS lifecycle messaging in 2026 round-ups; official remote MCP and Claude plugin.

tools.name: Brevo
tools.why: Budget email plus SMS ESP with volume pricing, listed in 2026 round-ups (LA Growth Machine, Mailercloud); official remote MCP.

tools.name: beehiiv
tools.why: Newsletter-first platform with ad network and paid subscriptions, a top pick for media in 2026 round-ups; official MCP.

tools.name: React Email
tools.why: The dominant component library for coded email templates (19.8k GitHub stars; first-class with Resend, Next.js stacks).

tools.name: MJML
tools.why: Standard responsive-email markup language with 20+ components compiled to client-safe HTML.

tools.name: Constant Contact
tools.why: About 650,000 customers (EmailToolTester 2026 ranks it 3rd by users) and 5% business adoption, third behind Mailchimp and Klaviyo (Ramp, Sep 2026); the traditional small-business ESP, V3 REST API, no official MCP found.

tools.name: MailerLite
tools.why: Over 1 million users after 52% growth 2024-2026, ranked 2nd by users in EmailToolTester 2026, ahead of Kit; official MCP server listed in its developer docs.

tools.name: ActiveCampaign
tools.why: Third by email-software revenue share (2.07%, level with Klaviyo at 2.1%) and 180,000+ customers; the automation-plus-CRM ESP, with an official connector in the Claude directory since Nov 2025 (CMSWire). Note: guide mentions of ActiveCampaign are only as the owner of the Postmark skills repo.

tools.name: Salesforce Marketing Cloud
tools.why: Leader in the Aug 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Multichannel Marketing Hubs (with Braze and Adobe) and the default enterprise email platform, with its own AMPscript and SQL query skill set; docs page blocked automated fetch (403).

tools.name: Braze
tools.why: Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Multichannel Marketing Hubs, highest on ability to execute; cross-channel lifecycle for apps, email one channel among push and in-app, so minor for this small-to-mid craft.

tools.name: Adobe Marketo Engage
tools.why: Standard B2B marketing automation platform beside HubSpot; Ramp (Sep 2026) names Marketo the fastest-growing email marketing vendor; Adobe is a 2026 Gartner MMH Leader.

tools.name: Mailgun
tools.why: Named in every 2026 sending-API comparison next to SendGrid, Postmark and SES (SuprSend, Mailpro, EmailSendX) for granular API control; now part of Sinch.

tools.name: Omnisend
tools.why: Ecommerce ESP serving about 150,000 online stores after 50% growth 2024-2026 (EmailToolTester); main Klaviyo alternative for Shopify stores, with a documented Claude MCP connection.

tools.name: MXToolbox
tools.why: The free default for SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX and blacklist checks, recommended alongside Google Postmaster Tools in every 2026 deliverability-tool round-up (EmailVendorSelection, Omnisend, MailFlowAuthority); has a REST API.

tools.name: ZeroBounce
tools.why: Most-recommended list-verification service in 2026 deliverability round-ups (MailFlowAuthority, EmailVendorSelection), used to clean imports and old lists before sending; the guides cover hygiene but name no verifier.
